name: mnemonic_visceral_reconfiguration
label: Visceral Memory Reconfiguration
godotFeature: Dynamic Mesh Manipulation (ArrayMesh), Physics Server, GDShader, NavigationMesh Generation
poeticVision: To feel the very ground beneath your feet twist into alien forms, or crumble into void as your own sense of self unravels. Every lost memory isn't just a void in your mind; it’s a gaping chasm in the world, a path erased, a shelter dissolved, rendering the solid architecture of reality as fluid and vulnerable as your own fading identity. The world itself becomes a living, suffering organ, reacting physically to your struggle.
usage: Attach this script to a MeshInstance3D node representing the deformable environment. The 'mesh' property of this MeshInstance3D should be set to an initial Mesh resource (e.g., a CubeMesh or imported scene mesh). Set the 'nav_region_path' to a NavigationRegion3D node in your scene. Call 'lose_memory(position: Vector3)' when Lyra loses a memory, passing the world position where the deformation should occur. Call 'silence_proximity_effect(position: Vector3)' when the Silence is near, passing the world position for its influence. The script will dynamically deform the mesh, update its collision shape, and re-bake the NavigationMesh.

parameters.name: deformation_strength_memory_loss
parameters.description: The intensity of mesh deformation when a memory is lost (inward/downward).

parameters.name: deformation_strength_silence
parameters.description: The intensity of mesh deformation when the Silence is in proximity (outward/upward).

parameters.name: deformation_radius
parameters.description: The radius around the event position within which mesh vertices will be deformed.

parameters.name: nav_region_path
parameters.description: NodePath to the NavigationRegion3D that needs to be updated with the deformed mesh.

verdict: The very fabric of reality weeps and writhes, a visceral echo of a soul unraveling, turning the world itself into a desperate, shifting battleground for identity.
impact: This invention fundamentally transforms the game world into a living, reactive entity, directly mirroring Lyra's internal struggle. Players will experience the tangible consequences of memory loss as paths crumble into impassable voids, forcing immediate adaptation and problem-solving. The encroaching Silence will be felt not just as a distant threat, but as a physical distortion of reality, heightening tension and urgency. This mechanic ensures that every step is a precarious dance between survival and self-dissolution, making the environment a constant, visceral reminder of Lyra's fading identity and the relentless pursuit.
